notes.title: Cyberfield - Update v1.0.0.5
notes.content:
[h2]What's new?[/h2]

[h3]Added a new Champion![/h3]
Now the powerful Swordsman has become the new [b][i]Champion of Cyberfield[/i][/b] - his special techniques will definitely surprise even the most daring fighter.

[h3]Other[/h3]
The timings of attacks and shots of some units have been changed.
Black Titanium: increased the number of projectiles launched.
Archer: arrow speed has been slightly reduced.

notes.title: Cyberfield - Update v1.0.0.41
notes.content:
[h2]What's new?[/h2]

[h3]Added a new Champion![/h3]
Agile yet strong, [i][b]Black Titanium[/b][/i] has become the Champion of the Second Section, and now he's ready to face new contenders in ruthless combat.

[h3]New mechanics for starting Champion rounds[/h3]
Everything is done by the rules of fair battle: face-to-face positions, countdown, fight!

[h3]Other[/h3]
Fixed some minor bugs.
Minor balance adjustments.


See you at the Steel Arena!

notes.title: Cyberfield - Update v1.0.0.3
notes.content:
[h2]Whats new?[/h2]

[h3]Added 4 new player skills:[/h3]
- [b]Reflective Cover[/b]. Returns damage dealt to you back to the enemy;
- [b]Indomitable Spirit[/b]. Reduces damage taken from enemies;
- [b]Shards[/b]. When performing a special attack, releases some claws in a random direction;
- [b]Backstab[/b]. Adds damage to attacks from behind.

[h3]Balance changes:[/h3]
The cost of some upgrades in the Power Panel has been changed.
The health gain of enemies has been slightly increased.
Increased chance of stun from Megabot attacks.
Increased chance of critical strike from Robowalker attacks.
Other small changes.

[h3]Other:[/h3]
Added visual effect for backstabs.
Fixed a bug where the Samurai could freeze when trying to attack and heal at the same time.
Changed the volume of some sounds.
Fixed an error with slight overlap of words in the descriptions of skills and enhancers for Chinese and Japanese languages.
